notes: No code changed by this seat; every line was proven against e188f63. Gaps for the owner, needing design rather than code: (1) Under a custom policy, a rule whose id is not a shipped id is shown to the model as '(custom id)', so the memo cannot cite it and system rule 8 ('names each rule referred or failed') cannot be met for it. A probe with a custom R4242 rule and the offline model exited 0 and grounded, but its Recommendation named only R3-R5. The appendix still shows the full table to the reviewer. Choose whether the prompt should carry a placeholder id that can be cited (e.g. C1..Cn mapped back). (2) A custom rule whose id equals a shipped id (R2) but has a different meaning is sent as R2; its description is masked, so no free text leaks. (3) No remote alert exists by design (local-first); refusals exit 2. (4) Removing SDK retries means a transient 5xx/429 now fails the draft at once (exit 4) where it used to retry twice; any retry with backoff belongs in HostedLLM.complete, where each attempt re-checks the lock. That is a design choice for the owner, not added here.
